entities.name: Nationalities Crisis & WWI
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Growing tensions with Slavic, Romanian, and other minorities. Hungary entered WWI as part of the Central Powers, suffering enormous casualties. The collapse of the Dual Monarchy and the armistice (November 1918) ended the old order.
